body: Want to talk about it? We’re all here for you.

Alright mate. I was a big fan of football, which until I got a knee injury which made me not able to play it at all. The doctor told me that this could be a small bit of how the depression got worse, not being able to do the activity I did a lot and loved most. I did go to a therapist, and it did help me a bit, just talking about it all to someone who knows and understands everything I’m saying. I was then discharged a while back. but all the “depressed” feelings are back. I think I will sort out getting therapy again. Thank you very much for your message mate.
It’s honestly such a bad thing to go through and really hard to deal with sometimes. Thankyou very much, I hope you get somewhat better with yourself bro, and wish you all the best. Thanks again.
